slot.brief: Simple ranking of 5-6 people by height or weight with direct comparison statements; determine who is tallest / middle of the order.

stem: Among five friends Aman, Bhavna, Chirag, Deepa and Esha, Aman is taller than Bhavna but shorter than Chirag. Deepa is shorter than Bhavna. Esha is taller than Chirag. Who is the tallest?

verdicts.working: Esha > Chirag > Aman > Bhavna > Deepa, so Esha is tallest.

working:
Chain them: Aman is taller than Bhavna (Aman > Bhavna) but shorter than Chirag (Chirag > Aman); Deepa is shorter than Bhavna (Bhavna > Deepa); Esha is taller than Chirag (Esha > Chirag).
So Esha > Chirag > Aman > Bhavna > Deepa, which makes Esha the tallest.
Aman and Chirag both fall below Esha, so options A and C fail; Bhavna is near the bottom, so option B fails; only option D stands at the top.

Independent check: Esha > Chirag > Aman > Bhavna > Deepa, so Esha is tallest.
solution: The height order is $\text{Esha} > \text{Chirag} > \text{Aman} > \text{Bhavna} > \text{Deepa}$. Hence, Esha is the tallest.
